title: coccoloba punctata var. microstachya

The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, diarrhea, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Seagrape include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
